description: C4: the Hearth-hold's lead toward the Frostbound Titan (milestone D builds him; nothing of him is here). Once Last Hearth's beacon burns (tier 3's life), Maera tells what its watchers saw on the Hoarcrown's road; the giant looks from the Hoarwatch (its waystone the Hearth raised at tier 2), and the lead is noted for milestone D (lead.frostbound.hearth). XP: Maera 100 (her dialogue), the look 150.

stages.objective: Hear what the beacon's watchers saw
stages.waiting_text: Maera keeps Last Hearth; its beacon's watchers have seen something on the Hoarcrown.

stages.objective: Look from the Hoarwatch toward the Hoarcrown's road
stages.waiting_text: The Hoarwatch stands above the Colossus Steps; Last Hearth's waystone there carries you close.
